Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Monika Zellner,

Thank you for setting out your allocation, contract term and lead time. We recognise that constrained capacity calls for firm commitments rather than forecast growth alone.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Our analysis supports these proposals: each offers binding annual quantities under a longer agreement, conditional on confirmed allocation and a reliable delivery schedule. We are flexible on lead time; the extended lead-time option gives you more production flexibility, so please indicate which works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 42 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 26.27 per unit, lead time 56 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 35 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.

Could you send a delivery schedule with the monthly quantities you can commit to?

We look forward to agreeing a dependable supply arrangement with you.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your preference for a 24-month agreement at 23,400 units per year. To ensure reliable supply at this increased volume, we select the 56-day lead time option. 

Based on these parameters, our offer is a price of €31.90 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a Lieferzeit of 56 days. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
